zh: 首页新增交互式新手引导与遮罩管理，支持跳过与随时在个人菜单重放，并与自动导入弹窗及工具模式深度隔离。
离开未保存工具页面统一采用 AppDialog 对话框守卫并支持浅色主题；同步优化管理员与超级管理员身份徽章和导航路由去重。
新增 Android 与 iOS 移动端多架构并行自动构建工作流，打通 App Store Connect API 凭据并保持全端版本号对齐。
en: Add an interactive homepage product tour with backdrop isolation, modal evasion, and replay from the user menu.
Unify unsaved leave-page guards with AppDialog, add light-theme surface styles, polish admin and superadmin badges, and normalize sidebar shortcut paths.
Integrate automated Android APK and iOS build jobs into GitHub Actions with App Store Connect API credentials and aligned release versions.
